subject: Integration demo timetable and redaction pack
messages:
From: Linda Park <linda.park@finedge.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>, marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo + samples for integration POC

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Thanks again for the intro last week. We're ready to run a hands-on integration session to validate routing, prompt templates, and a short load ramp so we can estimate QPS and latency for our core flows. Key asks from our side:

- A 60-90 minute working session where your SEs can pair with our engs and run real prompts against a sandbox endpoint
- Guidance on redaction: we will share sample payloads but need a checklist for PII removal and tokenization expectations
- A light load test plan (ramp from 1 -> 25r/s over 10 minutes) so we can baseline throughput

We've started collating a small set of representative prompts and payloads — I can share a redacted bundle once we confirm a date. Preferable days are Wed/Thu this week (6/16-6/17) mornings PT.

Thanks,
Linda Park
Director, Platform Engineering
FinEdge
[Attachment: sample_list_index.txt]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwoodinference.com>
To: Linda Park <linda.park@finedge.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa@redwoodinference.com>, dev_patel <dev@redwoodinference.com>, stephanie_nguyen <stephanie@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Jun 2027 10:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo + samples for integration POC

Hi Linda — great, happy to run this. Proposed plan below and a couple of asks up front so we can make the workshop productive.

Proposed session (90 minutes):
- 10m: Introductions + scope (routing targets, expected traffic shape)
- 25m: Prompt review and templating (we'll walk through 6 canonical prompts you send)
- 25m: Live routing test and KV/prefix caching demo
- 20m: Load ramp and baseline capture (we'll run your 1->25 r/s plan in a sandbox)
- 10m: Action items / follow-ups (rollout checklist, artifacts)

Dates we can support (all PT):
- Wed 2027-06-16: 10:00 - 11:30 (preferred)
- Thu 2027-06-17: 09:00 - 10:30

Prep items for FinEdge: (please share these 48 hours before session)
- 6 representative prompts + 12 short/long payloads (jsonl preferred)
- Redaction sample + a short note on what you consider PII for this dataset
- Any IP/response constraints or rate limits we should respect during the ramp

I've attached a light template for the payload bundle and a starter load plan (see stubs below). We'll also create a shared Drive folder and a HubSpot mutual action plan.

Attachments: redaction_checklist_v1.pdf (stub), load_plan_template.csv (stub)

Looking forward — I'll hold the 6/16 slot on my calendar tentatively. If that works, Marissa can send the invite and we'll include your engineering leads.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik@redwoodinference.com
[Attachment: redaction_checklist_v1.pdf]

Subject: Re: Demo + samples for integration POC

Linda — quick note from GTM: 6/16 at 10:00 PT works for Redwood, but our CS lead Stephanie has a conflict until 10:15. Would you be OK shifting start to 10:15 so we can include CS for the rollout discussion? If not, we can keep 10:00 and loop Stephanie for the second half.

Also looping Dev (SE) to confirm the sandbox endpoint and temp keys will be provisioned ahead of time. Dev — can you confirm the sandbox will accept the redacted jsonl format and whether there are token-length limits we should call out?

Marissa Cole

marissa@redwoodinference.com

Thanks — 10:15 PT on Wed 6/16 is fine for us. Confirming attendees: Linda Park (platform), Samir Rao (backend lead), and one SRE.

I've uploaded a redacted bundle to the Drive folder (see link):
- finedge_redacted_samples_v1.jsonl (redacted fields: email, ssn, account_number)
- finedge_eval_prompts_v1.txt (6 canonical prompts + expected success criteria)
- load_ramp_plan.csv (ramp plan 1 -> 25 r/s over 10min)

A couple of clarifications:
- We intentionally left some long context fields in the samples to confirm tokenization behavior; please let us know if we should truncate further.
- For the load ramp, please use a sandbox model variant with soft rate-limits so our SRE can collect metrics without tripping prod protections.

Forwarding your checklist — see quoted below.
